messages:
maria: quick RFC follow-up — we need to finalize the rollout/lease metadata that ships with model manifests. main question: how do we express "stability" vs "affinity" so runtime can make placement + fallback decisions without backcompat headaches?
noah: agreed. tradeoff summary: short leases reduce memory pressure but create churn and cold starts; strong pins reduce churn but block autoscale and make rollbacks harder. propose minimal field set: canonical_model_id, version_hash, stability_level, lease_seconds, affinity_hint, fallback_priority. keep semantics simple and default-safe.
sara: +1. propose stability_level enum: stable | sticky | ephemeral | canary. "sticky" = soft pin with a grace window for eviction. also add owner and rollout_stamp for audit.
priya: we should also expose an alias mapping so clients can pin to a logical name but resolver can map to a concrete hash: resolves_to: [version_hash, legacy_tag]. helps during model rehost/migration. migration strategy: make new keys optional, runtime assumes sensible defaults.
deploy-bot: :robot_face: canary rollout scheduled — testing sticky semantics on dedicated-gpu-2 pool at 2026-03-20T14:02Z.
noah: suggested example manifest (minimal):
```
{
  "canonical_model_id": "rwd/llamax-13b",
  "version_hash": "sha256:1a2b3c4d5e6f...",
  "stability_level": "sticky",
  "lease_seconds": 86400,
  "affinity_hint": "tenant",
  "fallback_priority": ["pinned_same_tenant", "compatible_variant", "second_region"],
  "rollout_stamp": "2026-03-18T21:10Z"
}
```
noah: semantics notes: fallback_priority is ordered; runtime should try earlier items first but may skip to cheaper/closer options under pressure. version_hash must be authoritative when present; resolver can use resolves_to when aliasing. avoid last-writer-wins for canonical_id updates — prefer an explicit roll-forward token or monotonic rollout_stamp.
maria: nice. next steps: I'll open a tiny RFC PR with the schema, validation rules, and defaults (sticky default lease 86400, ephemeral 3600). include a 2-week deprecation window for any existing fields we rename. also add telemetry points: lease_granted, lease_revoked, fallback_used, alias_resolve_time.
priya: :thumbsup: I'll add unit tests for resolver edgecases (alias loops, missing version_hash) and a small fuzz check for fallback ordering.
